mapper.sql: id, meter_id, meter_name,ip, port,address,type,up_region_id,total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power,total_negative_positive_power, create_time, create_person, update_time, update_person, is_deleted, total_positive_power_difference_value,total_positive_reactive_power_difference_value, total_negative_positive_power_difference_value,magnification_coefficient

meter_id, meter_name,ip, port,address,type,up_region_id,total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power,total_negative_positive_power, create_time, create_person, update_time, update_person, is_deleted, total_positive_power_difference_value,total_positive_reactive_power_difference_value, total_negative_positive_power_difference_value,magnification_coefficient
mapper.select: SELECT b.total_positive_power, b.total_positive_reactive_power, b.total_negative_positive_power, (CASE WHEN b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power <= 0 or b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power END ) AS totalPositivePowerDifferenceValue, (CASE WHEN b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power <= 0 or b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power END ) AS totalPositiveReactivePowerDifferenceValue, (CASE WHEN b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power <= 0 or b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power END ) AS totalNegativePositivePowerDifferenceValue, b.create_time, b.magnification_coefficient FROM ( SELECT total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power, create_time, magnification_coefficient, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_meter_log where meter_id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY lastTime ORDER BY create_time )b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power, create_time, magnification_coefficient, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_meter_log where meter_id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY lastTime ORDER BY create_time ) a ON b.lastTime = DATE_ADD(a.lastTime,INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT (CASE WHEN b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power <= 0 or b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power END ) AS totalPositivePowerDifferenceValue, (CASE WHEN b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power <= 0 or b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power END ) AS totalPositiveReactivePowerDifferenceValue, (CASE WHEN b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power <= 0 or b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power >= 10 THEN 0 ELSE b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power END ) AS totalNegativePositivePowerDifferenceValue FROM ( SELECT total_positive_power,total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power FROM t_meter_log, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(collect_power_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime, id FROM t_meter WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} )c WHERE meter_id = c.id AND create_time >= c.lastTime ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 1 ) b, ( SELECT total_positive_power,total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power FROM t_meter_log a, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(collect_power_time, INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastTime, id, DATE_FORMAT(collect_power_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as collectTime FROM t_meter WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} )d WHERE meter_id = d.id AND create_time <= d.collectTime AND create_time >= d.lastTime ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 1 ) a
mapper.delete: delete from t_meter_log WHERE create_time lt; DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH);
mapper.insert: insert into t_meter_log () values ( #{id}, #{name}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{address}, #{type},#{upRegionId}, #{totalPositivePower}, #{totalPositiveReactivePower}, #{totalNegativePositivePower}, now(), '0', now(), '0', 0, #{totalPositivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{totalPositiveReactivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{totalNegativePositivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{magnificationCoefficient} )
